stories.title: COLDCARD wallet RNG flaw likely linked to $88 million Bitcoin theft

stories.title: UK government investment arm cops to 40-hour leak of officials' contact details
stories.summary: UK Government Investments (UKGI) admitted that a staff member left an internal file—containing the names and work‑email addresses of 51 high‑level government officials—publicly accessible for roughly 40 hours during the 2025‑26 financial year, a lapse that violated its own security policies.
